recipe.visualDefinition: A digitally painted album cover featuring a central portrait of a distressed individual against an explosive background, framed within a faux-canvas border, set against a solid reddish-orange background. Distressed white typography for the main title and a smaller, clean sans-serif subtitle are placed above the framed artwork. A parental advisory label is in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The central framed painting is the primary focal point, depicting a figure in distress against a fiery, chaotic background.
The main title typography is large, distressed, and positioned prominently above the artwork, establishing a strong visual hierarchy.
The solid reddish-orange background acts as a unifying field, contrasting with the detailed artwork and providing a canvas for the typography.
The parental advisory label serves as a small, distinct informational element, contrasting in style and placement with the main artwork and typography.
coreInvariants: The central image must be a painted-style portrait of a person in distress, with a chaotic, fiery background.
The main title must be in a distressed, uppercase serif or slab-serif style, positioned centrally above the artwork.
The overall color palette must be dominated by warm tones of red, orange, and brown.
A 'Parental Advisory Explicit Content' label must be present in the bottom right corner.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The framed artwork is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space and 70% of the horizontal space. The figure within the painting is slightly off-center to the left, filling a significant portion of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The framed painting serves as the primary visual anchor, drawing the eye with its detailed and dramatic content.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the main title, then down to the central figure in the painting, and finally scans the chaotic background before settling on the parental advisory label. The fiery background creates a sense of upward and outward movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid reddish-orange background provides ample negative space around the framed artwork and typography, allowing them to stand out without feeling cluttered. The top portion of the background is particularly open, emphasizing the main title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The reddish-orange background (similar to burnt sienna or terracotta) serves as the dominant color, providing a warm, earthy, and intense base for the entire composition.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The white of the main title and the lighter tones in the figure's shirt and skin provide high contrast against the dominant background and the darker elements of the painting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The vibrant reds and oranges within the explosion and the figure's jacket act as strong accents, drawing attention and conveying intensity and urgency.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is moderately saturated and mid-value. The painting features a wide range of values, from dark browns and blacks to bright oranges and yellows, with high saturation in the fiery elements. The typography is high-value (white) with moderate saturation due to its distressed texture.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool colors as dominant or accent tones.
Maintain a warm, earthy, and intense color scheme.
Limit the use of highly saturated colors to accents within the artwork.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The main title uses an uppercase, bold, condensed slab-serif or sturdy serif typeface. The subtitle uses an uppercase, regular weight, geometric sans-serif typeface. The parental advisory label uses a condensed, bold sans-serif typeface.
letterConstructionRules: Main Title: Characters are uppercase, with strong serifs/slabs. Heavy distressing is applied, giving a worn, chipped, and textured appearance, especially at edges and within strokes. The distressing should be organic and irregular.
Subtitle: Characters are uppercase, with consistent stroke width and geometric forms. No distressing.
Parental Advisory: Characters are uppercase, bold, and condensed. No distressing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main Title: The distressing is unique to each character, creating a hand-worn effect. The 'R' has a particularly prominent distressed leg. The periods between letters are small and solid, not distressed.

composition.relationshipToImage: positioned above and visually connected to the artwork through thematic intensity
provides context to the main title and artwork

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a distressed, heavy display font with a clean, simple sans-serif for supporting text and functional labels.
graphicDevices: Distressing/texture applied to main title typography.
A rectangular frame around the central painting, mimicking a canvas border.

preserve: The distressed, worn texture of the main title.
The uppercase and condensed nature of all text elements.
The clean, geometric forms of the subtitle and parental advisory text.
The color white for all typography.
avoid: Light or thin weights for the main title.
Serif typefaces for the subtitle or parental advisory label.
Smooth, clean appearance for the main title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rockwell, Playbill, or similar slab-serif with heavy distressing
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bold, blocky, and impactful feel of the main title, with distressing added as a post-processing effect.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact, Anton, or similar condensed sans-serif for main title with distressing
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed form, requiring distressing to achieve the desired texture.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Montserrat, Open Sans, or similar geometric sans-serif for subtitle
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, uppercase, and geometric characteristics of the subtitle.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Bebas Neue, Oswald, or similar condensed sans-serif for Parental Advisory
candidateDirections.reason: Replicates the bold, condensed, and functional style of the parental advisory text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital painting with a dominant reddish-orange background. In the center, create a framed artwork depicting a distressed individual against a chaotic, fiery, and explosive background. Ensure the painting has a distinct, visible frame. Leave clear space above the framed artwork for the main title and subtitle, and in the bottom right corner for the parental advisory label.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title 'R.A.M.B.O.' in a large, distressed white slab-serif font, centered above the framed artwork. Below it, add the subtitle 'RISE AGAINST MY BROKEN ODDS' in a smaller, clean, uppercase white geometric sans-serif font, also centered. In the bottom right corner, place the 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' label in its standard black box with white condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the main title distressed and uppercase?
Is the subtitle clean, uppercase, and smaller than the main title?
Is the framed artwork centrally placed and visually dominant?
Are the colors predominantly warm (reds, oranges, browns)?
Is the Parental Advisory label correctly positioned and styled?

adjustableVariables: Specific shades of reddish-orange for the background.
Intensity and detail of the distressing on the main title.
Exact style of the framed artwork (e.g., more painterly vs. more graphic).
The specific facial expression and pose of the figure in the painting.
The level of chaos and detail in the explosive background.

mustAchieve: A sense of raw emotion and intensity conveyed through the central artwork.
A clear visual hierarchy with the main title and artwork as primary focal points.
A cohesive warm color palette that supports the intense mood.
A distressed, impactful aesthetic for the main title.
avoid: A clean, polished, or minimalist aesthetic.
Legibility issues with the main title due to excessive distressing.
A generic or uninspired central figure in the painting.

postGenerationChecks: Does the main title 'R.A.M.B.O.' appear distressed and uppercase?
Is the subtitle 'RISE AGAINST MY BROKEN ODDS' clean, uppercase, and centered?
Is the central artwork a framed painting of a distressed figure against an explosion?
Is the background a solid reddish-orange color?
Is the 'Parental Advisory' label present in the bottom right corner?
Does the overall image convey a sense of intensity and grit?
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate the central framed artwork with a new distressed figure and chaotic background, maintaining the painted style and warm color palette. Replace the main title with new distressed uppercase text, and the subtitle with new clean uppercase text, preserving their relative sizes and positions. Ensure the reddish-orange background and Parental Advisory label are consistent.
